## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector participation vs mixed mega-cap internals (strong 1M tech winners vs multiple 1W reversals). Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%), PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +0.31%), XOM RECOVERY (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -4.99%).  
Consumer Staples strong: MO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%), WMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +5.50%).  
Technology showing upside on breadth: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials lag: FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -7.39%), NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -4.54%), SHW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%).  
Consumer Discretionary mixed/soft: BKNG CORRECTION (1W: -5.89% | 1M: +1.34%), some names like SBUX ABOVE TREND offset.  
Healthcare weak overall: ISRG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%), MO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%), GD RECOVERY (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%). Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: Growth/Momentum tilt given large tech winners.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%), ISRG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%), VST CORRECTION (1W: -5.52% | 1M: +0.86%), SHW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%), BKNG CORRECTION (1W: -5.89% | 1M: +1.34%). Weakness concentrated in pockets of Tech and Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%), QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%), GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%), MO (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%), GD (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%). Major divergence present — NVDA, MSFT, META show 1W/1M mismatch (CORRECTION/Trend exhaustion), so treat strength as tactical not fully structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed: GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) versus NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) and META CORRECTION (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%); Tech breadth constructive but internals uneven.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +6.33%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +9.89%), MA CORRECTION (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +0.95%); Financials showing steady participation and supporting overall breadth.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Caution: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +34.60%) and LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%) offset broader weakness where several large names are BELOW TREND; sector skewed toward stock-specific drivers.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor names showing confirmed strength (GOOGL ABOVE TREND, INTC ABOVE TREND, QCOM ABOVE TREND, MPC ABOVE TREND, CAT ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to names in CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (NVDA CORRECTION, META CORRECTION, ISRG BELOW TREND, FCX BELOW TREND); style: Growth/Momentum tilt but with selectivity given internals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%).  
BEARISH: NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%), META CORRECTION (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%), SHW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (MPC, PSX) — sector 1W:+4.25% and Consumer Staples (MO) for defensive participation.  
BEARISH: Materials and parts of Healthcare where multiple names are BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: watch resistance / failed bounce as sell-signal while in CORRECTION (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%).  
GOOGL: break above recent high would extend ABOVE TREND momentum (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%).  
JPM: sustained above-monthly gains would confirm Financials participation (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +6.33%).  
XOM: watch follow-through from RECOVERY (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -4.99%) for Energy rotation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GD (+80): GD RECOVERY (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) — guidance upgrade confirmed by strong 1W move.  
SBUX (+75): SBUX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.33% | 1M: +17.11%) — price confirms upbeat guidance.  
LLY (+60): LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%) — headline momentum aligning with gains.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
SHW (-50): SHW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) — negative commentary confirmed by price weakness.  
(Also monitor GE (-60) and LMT (-55) from the news list for operational guidance risk; returns not shown in this summary but these headlines warrant attention.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given large tech winners and broad sector participation. GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) and QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across mega-caps (NVDA, MSFT, META in CORRECTION/Trend exhaustion) and selected negative news (SHW) — monitor for trend confirmation before enlarging exposure.
